items.title: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces the general availability of GPT-6 Astra from OpenAI on Amazon Bedrock.

items.title: Amazon SageMaker Feature Store now supports individual feature updates to lower write latency
items.blurb: Amazon SageMaker Feature Store is a fully managed capability that makes it easy to compute, store, and retrieve features for training and deploying AI models.

items.title: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB 3 now supports custom plugins
items.blurb: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB now lets you run your own custom Python plugins on the managed versions of InfluxDB 3 Core and Enterprise editions.

items.title: AWS Transform is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
items.blurb: AWS Transform is now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) Region, enabling government agencies and regulated organizations to plan and execute large-scale migrations to AWS.

items.title: Amazon API Gateway now supports mutual TLS for backend integrations
items.blurb: You can now configure Amazon API Gateway REST APIs to present an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate to your backend during the TLS handshake, enabling mutual TLS (mTLS).

items.title: Amazon RDS for MariaDB now supports community MariaDB minor versions 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, and 12.3.3
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for MariaDB now supports MariaDB minor versions 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, and 12.3.3, the latest minors released by community MariaDB.

items.title: Azure Virtual Desktop Hybrid Reaches GA with Licensing Details Unpublished
items.blurb: Microsoft has made Azure Virtual Desktop Hybrid generally available. Session hosts run on customer hardware through Azure Arc while brokering stays in Azure.
